LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.browseTicks.Desc: How long a guest looks at an item before deciding. 60 ticks is one second at normal speed.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.dayOpen.Desc: Hour the 'Day' preset in the sign's hours dialog opens.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.drinkGapHours.Desc: A guest does not order another drink before this many hours have passed.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.eveningClose.Desc: Hour the 'Evening' preset closes (an earlier hour than opening means after midnight).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.hideVanilla.Desc: When a Hearth & Harbor building replaces a vanilla one (for example the card table for the poker table), the vanilla one disappears from the build menu once the replacement is available. Buildings you already placed stay. Takes effect after a restart or the next game load.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.marketCaravans.Desc: How many trader caravans come on market day (fewer if few factions are friendly).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.marketDays.Desc: Average interval of the big market, with a little randomness.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.marketEnabled.Desc: Every so often friendly factions bring several trader caravans and day visitors at once. Only happens while you run at least one shop.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.marketVisitors.Desc: How many groups of day visitors come on market day, to shop in your venues.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.maxPurchases.Desc: A guest stops shopping after this many purchases in one stay.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.nightBell.Desc: Guests may ring a bell for a venue that is closed. Awake colonists with the Serving work type come and open it for a surcharge. Nobody is woken up.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellMin.Desc: A bell service never costs less than this (silver).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellSurcharge.Des: Extra share of the price that guests pay when they ring the bell outside opening hours.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.nightBellWaitHours.Des: How long a guest waits after ringing before giving up ('Rang the bell. Nobody came.').
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.priceTolerance.Desc: How much guests put up with. Above 1 they accept steeper prices, below 1 they haggle with their feet. Follows the difficulty slider.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.selfService.Desc: Venues that do not need staff but have nobody behind the counter charge this much less (the guest fetches everything themselves).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.shopDesire.Desc: How eagerly guests walk into shops and taverns compared with other things they could do. 0 = they never shop.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.shopPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of goods sold in shops and taverns, on top of each sign's own price factor.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.tendHours.Desc: How long a colonist tends a venue before looking for other work (they also stop when it closes).
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.vendingPrice.Desc: Multiplies the market value of what vending machines sell.
LanguageData.HH.Setting.venues.waitForStaffTicks.Desc: A guest waits this long for somebody to come to an open but unstaffed venue, then gives up annoyed.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.CheckNoCounter: No counter (optional) → the tender stands next to the sign
LanguageData.HH.Venue.CheckNoDrinks: No drinks in stock → store beer or other drinks in the room
LanguageData.HH.Venue.CheckNoStock: No goods for sale → put a shelf or stockpile with goods in the room
LanguageData.HH.Venue.CheckNoWorker: Nobody has the Serving work type switched on
LanguageData.HH.Venue.ChooseTypeDesc: Choose what kind of business the room of this sign is: tavern, shop, restaurant, casino, spa or lounge.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.ColonyMayTakeDesc: Off: goods for sale in this room are forbidden for your colonists, so nobody carries your stock away. On: colonists treat the goods like any other stored item.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.HoursDesc: Set when the business is open. Presets for day, evening, night and around the clock.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.HoursHint: A closing hour earlier than the opening hour means the business stays open past midnight.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.MarketText: Word has spread: it is market day. {0} trader caravans and {1} groups of visitors from {2} are on their way to your colony. Traders will trade as usual at their camps; visitors will browse your shops and taverns if they are open.\n\nKeep your shelves stocked and your counters staffed.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.NoRoom: Not a business yet: the sign needs an enclosed, roofed room.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.PriceDesc: Price factor on everything this business sells. Guests are put off by prices that are too high.
LanguageData.HH.Venue.PriceHint: Guests compare the price with what the item is worth to them. Wealthy guests put up with more. Venues without anybody on duty charge a little less (self-service); a night bell service costs extra. Free means free.
